format: Voice packs: AAC-LC 64 kbps, mono, 24 kHz, .m4a with faststart, built by decoding every per-line clip and joining them with 0.1 s of silence at the start and 0.35 s between lines (levels untouched, -18 LUFS from the producers). offset and dur are seconds from the start of the decoded pack. Lines are keyed by script path where one exists (A cast clips keep their old id as alias). Each item names its stamp_rule because the four producers used different ones. VO-BANK-Q and VO-BANK-FU share one pack per topic, each question followed by its follow-up.

VO-NARR-D.stamp_rule: FCV.stamp: FNV-1a of the source text, base36, 6 characters
